sources.title: furiosa-ai/Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407-FP8 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407-FP8 is a non-reasoning chat model and does not require a reasoning parser or model-specific chat-template flags. For general serving options, see the Furiosa-LLM Server guide.

sources.title: mistralai/Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: We're on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.

sources.title: Model Card for Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407
sources.snippet: The Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407 Large Language Model (LLM) is an instruct fine-tuned version of the Mistral-Nemo-Base-2407. Trained jointly by Mistral AI and NVIDIA, it significantly outperforms existing models smaller or similar in size.

sources.title: Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Q: What is the difference between mistralai/Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407 and the NVIDIA variant Mistral-NeMo-12B-Instruct? A: Both are identical in base model architecture and performance. The NVIDIA variant includes FP8 quantization options with no accuracy loss and deeper integration with the NeMo framework.

sources.title: mistral-nemo • LM Studio
sources.snippet: A slightly larger 12B parameter model from Mistral AI, NeMo offers a long 128k token context length, advanced world knowledge, and function calling for developers.
